title: Lucknow Session Of INC 1916 Lucknow Pact
definition: The 1916 Lucknow Session of the Indian National Congress (INC) marked the historic reunion of the Moderates and Extremists after the Surat Split of 1907, and witnessed the formalizing of the Lucknow Pact between the INC and the All-India Muslim League.
importanceInUpsc: This topic is a perpetual favorite in UPSC Prelims (chronology, leaders, pact provisions) and provides vital structural dimensions for Mains GS-1 regarding the evolution of Indian nationalism, Hindu-Muslim political dynamics, and constitutional reforms.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Lucknow Session Of INC 1916 Lucknow Pact.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Rise of Extremism and Home Rule Movement
